title.en: Why this month's Microsoft patch release is a doozy
title.zh: 为什么本月的微软补丁发布很精彩

summary.en: Security gnomes are pumping out patches ahead of an expected onslaught of AI-assisted attacks.
summary.zh: 在人工智能辅助攻击预计将到来之前，安全专家们正在发布补丁。

title.en: Hackers are stealing Claude tokens from subscribers
title.zh: 黑客正在从订阅者那里窃取克劳德代币

summary.en: Last month, a Claude user noticed his account was consuming tokens even though he wasn't working. Anthropic has since warned users about hackers.
summary.zh: 上个月，一位 Claude 用户注意到他的帐户正在消耗代币，即使他没有工作。此后，Anthropic 向用户发出了关于黑客的警告。

title.en: Cognition hits $48B valuation, signaling investors believe AI coding is far from a winner-take-all market
title.zh: Cognition 估值达到 48B 美元，表明投资者相信人工智能编码远非赢家通吃的市场

summary.en: Cognition's valuation multiple is higher than Cursor's was before selling to SpaceX.
summary.zh: Cognition 的估值倍数高于 Cursor 出售给 SpaceX 之前的估值倍数。

title.zh: ChatGPT Sketch 将你糟糕的绘图变成详细的 AI 图像

summary.en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Images 2.5 on Tuesday and is adding a new way to tell ChatGPT what you want it to make an image of: by drawing a doodle. With a new feature called Sketch,…

title.en: NVIDIA Announces CUDA Rust with cuda-oxide (SIMT) and cutile-rs (Tile) for Compile-Time-Safe GPU Kernels
title.zh: NVIDIA 宣布推出 CUDA Rust 以及 cuda-Oxide (SIMT) 和 cutile-rs (Tile)，用于编译时安全的 GPU 内核

title.en: How GPT-5.6 Sol helps run quantum computing experiments
title.zh: GPT-5.6 Sol 如何帮助运行量子计算实验

summary.en: See how an MIT researcher uses GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex to autonomously run quantum computing experiments, analyze results, and calibrate qubits.
summary.zh: 了解 MIT 研究人员如何使用 GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Codex 自主运行量子计算实验、分析结果和校准量子位。

title.en: AlphaGenome Atlas: A predictive map of every possible DNA letter change in the human genome
title.zh: AlphaGenome Atlas：人类基因组中每个可能的 DNA 字母变化的预测图

summary.en: AlphaGenome Atlas maps the molecular effects of 9 billion single-letter DNA variants across the human genome.
summary.zh: AlphaGenome Atlas 绘制了人类基因组中 90 亿个单字母 DNA 变体的分子效应。
